g.text: A drift term cuts the false flow on unconnected pairs but not to the limit

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is one setting of the step penalty, level penalty, and drift variance, scored on the big injected transfers of the tuning year (recall) and on the tuning year's two unconnected pairs (flow). Dashed lines: the 0.05 MW-days limit and the recall target. Recall was read for the first 24 settings, before the screen skipped it for settings over the flow limit, and for every setting under the limit.'
